name: Chijoku no Bijin OL
source:
Kawana Saeko is an elite office lady working at a major corporation. Her intelligent beauty makes her the object of admiration for all the male employees.
One day, her boss, Kageyama, orders her to work overtime. As Saeko passes her quitting time, a lewd smile appears on Kageyama's face...

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051120165353/http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=203621]Getchu[/url]]
